text:
Ravi: Morning team, Ravi here — excited to join! Quick Qs: 1) I brought a personal MacBook Air; can I enroll it in MDM or should I wait for a company laptop? 2) Where do I find the phishing sim schedule so I don’t freak out if I get one? 3) Any docs on handling customer data on a personal device?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ravi :tada: You can enroll your Mac into our MDM if you plan to use it for daily work. If you prefer a company laptop, submit the hardware request form and choose "new hire laptop" — we usually ship in 2 business days. Phishing sim schedule is on the onboarding site (see link in checklist). For personal device policy see: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/device-policy (short version: MDM + FileVault required if storing company data).
Noah (Security): Hey @Ravi — short checklist: enable FileVault (run `fdesetup status`), install the company VPN profile through MDM, and set an OS passcode. We require hardware 2FA (YubiKey) for anyone with repo/infra access; passkeys OK for non-privileged roles.
Ravi: Thanks — I mostly do docs and low-risk tasks. If I enroll personal device, will you see my personal apps or files?
Noah (Security): No, our MDM only enforces config and policies; we do not access personal files or apps. It reports OS version, disk encryption status, and installed company profiles.
Ravi: Nice. I tried the loaner form but it asked for office location; I work remote — what should I put?
Maya (People Ops): Put your home address and select "remote" for office location. If you need rush shipping, add a note and ping us here.
Ravi: Where do phishing sims come from? I want to make sure I don’t reply to a simulation by accident.
security-bot: Automated notice: Phishing simulations are sent from simulation@redwood-security.test and include "[Redwood Sim]" in the subject. If you report it via the report button, you will receive a short micro-training email. See: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims
Ravi: Great, thanks all. I I enroll now, is there any downtime while MDM applies?
Noah (Security): Minimal — MDM profile installs and a quick restart may be required for VPN certs. Expect ~10 minutes. If anything blocks you, ping security or people-ops.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome aboard again :rocket: Let us know if you want a company laptop — well prioritize shipping for devs.
